predictedBugs: A user with more than one active membership could receive an arbitrary tenant scope; the resolver limits to two rows and fails closed when more than one is present.
A successful bootstrap followed by an empty read could yield an unusable scope; the resolver re-queries and rejects an unresolved bootstrap without fabricating authority.
An assistant could persist the assistant user as legacy owner_id; all compatibility writes instead use the independently resolved active ownerUserId.
A forged WorkspaceScope could bypass a service-role client; the workspace repository re-verifies membership, role, workspace and active owner before privileged operations.
edgeCases: Zero active memberships invokes bootstrap_personal_workspace exactly once and then resolves again.
Two active memberships never invoke bootstrap and return an invariant error.
No unique active owner, revoked membership, sample mode and owner alias mismatch fail closed.
Duplicate assistant add and repeated revoke are delegated to idempotent owner-only RPCs with UUID correlation IDs.
